methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google incubator creates institutional AI capacity in Hampton Roads, but partnership model with tech giant signals deep capability concentrated in anchored metros rather than peer-distributed learning across smaller communities.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents grassroots capacity-building outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for distributed deep learning if local institutions can sustain capability beyond grant cycles.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies the concentration of defense AI expertise and capital in the region, widening the capability gap between metro defense corridor and non-defense economies statewide.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Workforce pressure from AI in Richmond suggests platform-driven automation creating broad but shallow displacement rather than deep capability development, pushing young workers toward tool adoption without fostering technical fluency.

signals.title: Teaching AI by Doing, Not Studying - Inside Higher Ed
signals.signal_reading: Pedagogical shift toward learning-by-doing rather than studying AI theory signals potential for distributed deep capability if this approach spreads through Virginia's diverse higher education network beyond research universities.
